'''Benay''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who sold items of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] in the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Benay first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
